title: Probing MechELK latent-knowledge elicitation on a small open 'quirky' model

original_idea.body: Probing MechELK (arXiv:2605.28825) latent-knowledge elicitation on open Quirky/Taboo model organisms with logit lens and linear probes, no SAE training. ELK is a core ARC open problem.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: ELK is a recognized critical safety problem; validating an elicitation framework on a model organism is a strong chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Logit lens + linear probes on existing open quirky models, no SAE training; guided and accessible with mentor.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused elicitation-accuracy-curve deliverable reusing existing model organisms; few dependencies.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: ELK is a neglected long-horizon ARC problem; model-organism probing on open weights is gold-standard counterfactual work.

low_compute.reasoning: Small open models, inference + light probe training on a single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Very recent framework; independent validation on quirky models likely not yet done.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Recent ELK framework not yet validated on these model organisms.
